statement: ∀ W : Submodule K (TensorLeft K M), stable (hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M x)) W → stable (hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M y)) W → ∀ i j, stable (scaledMatrix (K := K) lam x y M i j) W
proof:
have hfour := @yui_aux_0001 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T002 h_T003 h_T011 h_H005 h_H006
have hdiv := h_T003.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
intro W hx hy
have smul_stable (a : K) (f : Module.End K (TensorLeft K M))
    (hf : stable f W) : stable (a • f) W := by
  intro w hw
  exact W.smul_mem a (hf w hw)
have mul_stable (f g : Module.End K (TensorLeft K M))
    (hf : stable f W) (hg : stable g W) : stable (f * g) W := by
  intro w hw
  exact hf (g w) (hg w hw)
have pow_stable (f : Module.End K (TensorLeft K M))
    (hf : stable f W) (r : ℕ) : stable (f ^ r) W := by
  induction r with
  | zero => intro w hw; simpa using hw
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact mul_stable f (f ^ r) hf ih
have hxdiv (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ ell lam) :
    stable (hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r))) W := by
  rw [(hdiv r hr).1]
  exact smul_stable _ _ (pow_stable _ hx r)
have hydiv (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ ell lam) :
    stable (hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r))) W := by
  rw [(hdiv r hr).2]
  exact smul_stable _ _ (pow_stable _ hy r)
intro i j
apply smul_stable
rw [hfour i j]
exact mul_stable _ _ (mul_stable _ _ (mul_stable _ _
  (hxdiv _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)) (hydiv _ le_rfl)) (hxdiv _ le_rfl))
  (hydiv _ (Nat.sub_le _ _))

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type u_1) [instK : Field K] (lam : ℤ) (V : Type u_2) [instV : AddCommGroup V]
  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  ((∀ (j : Idx lam),
        0 < coeff lam j ∧
          coeff lam j * (↑j).factorial * (ell lam - ↑j).factorial = (ell lam).factorial ∧
            (ell lam).choose (ell lam - ↑j) = coeff lam j) ∧
      (projector lam x y) (ev y v (ell lam)) = ev y v (ell lam) ∧
        (∀ k < ell lam, (projector lam x y) (ev y v k) = 0) ∧
          (∀ (i j k : Idx lam),
              (integralMatrix lam x y i j) (ev y v ↑k) = if k = j then ↑(coeff lam j) • ev y v ↑i else 0) ∧
            (∀ (i j : Idx lam) (m : ↥M),
                (integralMatrix lam x y i j) ↑m ∈ M ∧
                  ↑(((fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j) m) = (integralMatrix lam x y i j) ↑m) ∧
              (∀ (i j k l : Idx lam),
                  (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j *
                      (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) k l =
                    if j = k then ↑(coeff lam j) • (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i l else 0) ∧
                ∑ i, ↑(coeffOmit lam i) • (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i i =
                    ↑(coeffProd lam) • 1 ∧
                  (∀ (i : Idx lam), coeffProd lam = coeff lam i * coeffOmit lam i) ∧
                    (∀ (r : ℕ),
                        ↑r.factorial • (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r = latticeEnd M x ^ r ∧
                          ↑r.factorial • (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r = latticeEnd M y ^ r) ∧
                      (∀ (r : ℕ) (m : ↥M),
                          ↑(((fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r) m) = (dividedPower x r) ↑m ∧
                            ↑(((fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r) m) = (dividedPower y r) ↑m) ∧
                        (∀ (m : ↥M),
                            x ↑m ∈ M ∧
                              y ↑m ∈ M ∧
                                h ↑m ∈ M ∧
                                  ↑((latticeEnd M x) m) = x ↑m ∧
                                    ↑((latticeEnd M y) m) = y ↑m ∧ ↑((latticeEnd M h) m) = h ↑m) ∧
                          latticeEnd M h = latticeEnd M x * latticeEnd M y - latticeEnd M y * latticeEnd M x ∧
                            ∀ (i j : Idx lam),
                              (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j =
                                (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam - ↑i) *

                                    (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam) *
                                  (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) (ell lam - ↑j)) →
    ↑(ell lam) = lam ∧
        ell lam < p ∧
          0 < ell lam + 1 ∧
            Nontrivial (TensorLeft K ↥M) ∧
              FiniteDimensional K (TensorLeft K ↥M) ∧
                Module.finrank K (TensorLeft K ↥M) = ell lam + 1 ∧

                    matrixUnits (scaledMatrix lam x y M) ∧
                      ((∀ (f g : Module.End ℤ ↥M), hat (f + g) = hat f + hat g ∧ hat (f * g) = hat f * hat g) ∧

                            hat 1 = 1 ∧
                              (∀ (q : ℕ) (fs : Fin q → Module.End ℤ ↥M), hat (∑ i, fs i) = ∑ i, hat (fs i)) ∧
                                (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (r : ℕ), hat (f ^ r) = hat f ^ r) ∧
                                  ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (a : K) (m : ↥M), (hat f) (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f m) ∧
                        (∀ r ≤ ell lam,
                            hat (latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • hat (latticeEnd M x) ^ r ∧
                              hat (latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • hat (latticeEnd M y) ^ r) ∧
                          hat (latticeEnd M h) =
                            hat (latticeEnd M x) * hat (latticeEnd M y) - hat (latticeEnd M y) * hat (latticeEnd M x) →
